title: Bug 638128: Deadlock in Duplicate Management when multiple users create customers at the same time
summary: Fixes a deadlock in Duplicate Management that could happen when several users create customers, and therefore contacts, at the same time. The change is a one-line addition to codeunit 5060 DuplicateManagement.
key_points: Resolves a deadlock in a read/check step of Duplicate Management
Triggered when multiple users create customers and contacts concurrently
